trans-unit.source: duration: {0}
trans-unit.target: duração: {0}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the total retry orchestration duration. Two leading spaces and the lowercase 'duration:' label mirror the platform run summary.

trans-unit.source: Retry summary: Failed! after {0}/{1} attempts
trans-unit.target: Resumo da repetição: falharam! após {0}/{1} tentativas
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of attempts used. {1} is the maximum number of attempts. Keep 'Retry summary:' and 'Failed!' parallel to the platform 'Test run summary: Failed!' wording.

trans-unit.source: failed: {0}
trans-unit.target: falhou: {0}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of tests still failing after the final attempt. Two leading spaces and the lowercase 'failed:' label mirror the platform run summary.

trans-unit.source: Retry summary: Failed! after {0} attempt(s) (retrying stopped early)
trans-unit.target: Resumo de novas tentativas: Falhou! após {0} tentativas (as novas tentativas foram interrompidas antecipadamente)
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of attempts that actually ran. Used when retrying was cut short by the failure threshold policy or by an attempt exiting unexpectedly, so the maximum attempt count would be misleading. Keep 'Retry summary:' and 'Failed!' parallel to the platform 'Test run summary: Failed!' wording. The '(s)' suffix follows the existing convention used elsewhere in this extension for counts that may be one.

trans-unit.source: flaky: {0} (passed after retry)
trans-unit.target: instável: {0} (aprovado após nova tentativa)
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of tests that failed at least once but eventually passed. Two leading spaces mirror the platform run summary. The parenthetical is important: it states that these tests are already included in the 'succeeded' count rather than forming a fourth outcome category alongside failed/succeeded/skipped.

trans-unit.source: {0} (failed -> passed)
trans-unit.target: {0} (falhou -> aprovado)
trans-unit.note: {0} is the display name of a flaky test. The arrow reads left (first outcome) to right (final outcome). Two leading spaces indent the entry under the 'Flaky tests:' header.

trans-unit.source: Flaky tests:
trans-unit.target: Testes instáveis:
trans-unit.note: Header of the section that lists, by name, the tests which failed at least once but eventually passed.

trans-unit.source: Retry summary: Passed! after {0}/{1} attempts
trans-unit.target: Resumo da repetição: aprovado! após {0}/{1} tentativas
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of attempts used. {1} is the maximum number of attempts. Keep 'Retry summary:' and 'Passed!' parallel to the platform 'Test run summary: Passed!' wording.

trans-unit.source: Retry summary: Passed! on the first attempt (no retries needed)
trans-unit.target: Resumo da repetição: aprovado! na primeira tentativa (nenhuma nova tentativa necessária)
trans-unit.note: Keep 'Retry summary:' and 'Passed!' parallel to the platform 'Test run summary: Passed!' wording.

trans-unit.source: retried: {0} test(s), {1} extra run(s)
trans-unit.target: reexecutados: {0} testes, {1} execuções extras
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of distinct tests that were re-run. {1} is the number of extra executions those retries cost. Two leading spaces and the lowercase 'retried:' label mirror the platform run summary. The '(s)' suffix follows the existing convention used elsewhere in this extension for counts that may be one.

trans-unit.source: skipped: {0}
trans-unit.target: ignorado: {0}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of skipped tests. Two leading spaces and the lowercase 'skipped:' label mirror the platform run summary.

trans-unit.source: succeeded: {0}
trans-unit.target: bem-sucedidos: {0}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the number of tests that ended up passing, counting those rescued by a retry. Two leading spaces and the lowercase 'succeeded:' label mirror the platform run summary.

trans-unit.source: total: {0}
trans-unit.target: total: {0}
trans-unit.note: {0} is the total number of tests in the suite. Two leading spaces and the lowercase 'total:' label mirror the platform run summary.
